full_details: In the shop he was cutting fine gloves by eye. He saw you coming at the debts and said Gilbert had been counting. He named the other baker at thirty shillings, the shoemaker under two pounds, and the skins at a few shillings. You did not correct him. Unasked, he brought a yellowed, mouse-nibbled scrap from behind the wainscot, the pattern of arms from his year as bailiff, and said they would have made him a gentleman once, and then wool fell. He asked whether a Queen's player has friends among the heralds. You said a player is a gentleman three hours every afternoon. Your mother remembered the colour of the ink and did not name it. The scrap went back. Nothing was filed, asked, or promised. The ticket stayed in your sleeve.
one_sentence: You let him name the debts small and saw the scrap once.
title: The old pattern shown once, and put back
